newsitem.title: USA: Clinton may make budget statement in Baltimore.
newsitem.headline: Clinton may make budget statement in Baltimore.

text.p: President Bill Clinton may make a public statement on efforts to reach a balanced budget agreement in Baltimore, where he is attending a retreat with Senate Democrats, a senior White House official said Friday.
The official, who asked not to be identified, said that Clinton needed to make a few phone calls in Baltimore and afterward might be in a position to announce a budget deal.

The official said that all that blocked an agreement was "working out some assurances that would satisfy Clinton on his concern about deficits balooning in the outyears and also fine adjustments that would give Clinton some additional funding for his domestic priorities."
The official said that the priorities included education, children's health care and welfare, but did not elaborate.
